qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Extreme local route density, 120-year Lindy brand equity (Orkin), and commercial compliance lock-in create insurmountable barriers to entry. Pest eradication is a non-discretionary sanitation necessity representing a negligible budget expense, enabling consistent 3-4%+ annual pricing realization with minimal churn. 10-year median GAAP ROIC of 35.3% and tangible ROIC >100% confirm moat endurance. Primary erosion risks: technician labor wage inflation, digital customer acquisition cost inflation, and tuck-in M&A integration friction.
qualitative.note: Passes all 6 gates. Global leader in route-based pest and termite control (Orkin, Fox, HomeTeam) operating an asset-light recurring subscription engine with 80%+ contract revenue. Unassailable local route density and 120-year Lindy brand equity deliver consistent 3-4% pricing power above inflation and 35%+ GAAP ROIC. Structurally insulated from all 5 macrotrends as physical pest eradication cannot be automated by AI and benefits from warming climate trends. Pristine balance sheet with net debt under 0.8x Net Income and 25x+ interest coverage. [5-10Y g: organic customer volume 4.0% + pricing realization 3.5% + tuck-in M&A 2.0% - technician wage/marketing drag 0.5% + share repurchases 0.5%]
qualitative.evidence: Empirical track record: 10-year median GAAP ROIC of 35.3% and tangible Operating ROIC >100%. Free cash flow conversion averaged 112% over 5 years (FY2025 Owner FCF of $610.3M on GAAP Net Income of $526.7M), supported by minimal capex intensity (~0.7% of sales, $28.1M in FY2025). Peak-to-peak Owner EPS compounded from $0.38 in 2016 to $1.29 in 2025 (13.7% CAGR) across 24 consecutive years of top-line revenue growth. Balance sheet remains exceptionally conservative: LT debt of $486.1M against $100.0M cash (net debt of $386.1M = 0.73x Net Income) and EBIT of $726.1M delivering 25.4x interest coverage. M&A strategy is self-funded from operating cash flows, with successful integration of Fox Pest Control ($339.5M in 2023) expanding route density.
